messages:
alex: Heads up — regional firewall lockdown in eu-west-3 just flipped to default-deny and we’re seeing GPU nodes fail to join the warm pool. Provisioning backlog spiking, some workloads falling back to other regions (costs rising). Anyone on call who can confirm KMS/privatelink egress is the blocker?
infra-bot: Alert: 3 failed node joins in eu-west-3 (warm-pool) — reason=network:egress_rejected, service=kms, affected=gpupool-az1 — triggered at 2026-03-21T09:42:10Z
sam: Looking. Can you paste the join logs from one of the failed nodes?
maria: grab from the canary: `journalctl -u gpu-join -n 200 | sed -n '1,120p'` — seeing TLS handshake to kms-endpoint timeouts + "connection refused" on 169.254.169.254 (IMDS) in the same window. Might be endpoint policy or natgw conntrack.
breakdown: 1) KMS decrypt calls timing out 2) STS token fetch failing 3) node boot script retries -> node evicted
ben: If STS can't fetch, the bootstrap fails early. Could be privatelink endpoint SG removal or a firewall rule denying 443 to kms. Any recent policy commits?
alex: We rolled the firewall baseline at 09:30 (default-deny for non-whitelisted egress). PR #4821 applied. I suspected it would impact some control-plane flows but thought keystore/proxy lives in privatelink.
sam: Checked VPC flow logs: connections to kms.rw-infra-eu-west-3.internal are RST/REJECT from fw-az1 for source in gpupool-subnet. Confirmed.
maria: Quick mitigation: allowlist kubelet bootstrap egress to kms and sts for the gpupool-subnet (temporary — 1hr). Command I propose: `aws ec2 modify-managed-prefix-list --prefix-list-id pl-zzzz --add-entries Cidr=10.32.0.0/22,Description=gpupool-kms-allow`
oncall: +1 to temporary allowlist. We need a short postmortem and a safer rule set. Can ops make the change and validate warm pool joins?
ben: I'll push the allowlist now and watch. Also recommend adding smoke checks: after firewall rollouts, run `scripts/egress-check --targets kms,sts,privatelink` against each subnet.
alex: Ben — can you estimate cost delta from cross-region fallback while this is blocked? We need to quantify for product.
ben: Rough calc: ~12 nodes failing -> fallback to on-demand eu-north-1 added ~3.5 GPU-hours -> ~$1.2k/hr extra at peak window (quick estimate). Full hour ramp could be ~1.2k.
sam: Allowlist applied, verifying flow logs... now seeing ACCEPT to kms endpoints. Warm pool join attempts requeued.
maria: Node canary shows successful STS and KMS decrypt after allowlist. Warm pool capacity restored slowly (workloads rebalancing).
alex: OK thanks. Action items: 1) rollback firewall baseline PR until we ship targeted egress policy (sam+infra) 2) add automated egress smoke tests (ben) 3) update runbook to check privatelink/privatedns interactions (maria) 4) cost note for finance (alex).
oncall: Noted. Will watch for reoccurrence in the next 2 hours and start a short incident doc. :white_check_mark:
maria: Also recommend we add a gating check in CI for infra-firewall PRs: `egress-check --subnets gpupool-subnet --targets kms,sts,imds`
alex: Good. Closing thread once incident doc is linked. Thanks all.
